BackgroundColorClass.helper: Optional. Choose a Bootstrap or shared site background for the full-width section.

CardBackgroundColorClass.helper: Choose the background for every timeline card. The template automatically chooses a contrasting text color.

CardImagePosition.helper: Choose whether moment images appear inside the card, outside the card on the opposite side of the timeline, or not at all.

CardVerticalSpacing.helper: Choose the vertical space between moment cards.

DateDisplayed.title: Date Displayed
DateDisplayed.helper: Choose whether moment dates are shown.

DateFormat.helper: Choose how displayed moment dates are formatted. Hide suppresses dates even when Date Displayed is Yes.

AnimationLevel.helper: Controls Porto entrance animation plus hover, shadow, rounding, and click feedback. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.

MarginTop.title: Margin (top)
MarginTop.helper: Optional. Controls spacing above this section.

MarginBottom.title: Margin (bottom)
MarginBottom.helper: Optional. Controls spacing below this section.

PaddingTop.title: Padding (top)
PaddingTop.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing above the content.

PaddingBottom.title: Padding (bottom)
PaddingBottom.helper: Optional. Controls inner spacing below the content.
